image_description: A white minibus parked on a paved street next to a brick building. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a large front windshield, a destination display above the windshield, side windows along the passenger area, and standard wheels. A license plate is visible on the front bumper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits a distinct boxy silhouette typical of minibuses, clearly shorter than a full-size coach but with sufficient height for passenger accommodation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is prominent, and multiple side windows are visible along the right side of the vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant vertical height relative to its width. The entrance door is located at the front-right side, consistent with the description.
The door structure at the front right shows panel lines consistent with a sliding or folding mechanism typical of this vehicle class.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is not visible in this frontal three-quarter view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with a dark stripe/livery and an illuminated destination sign, fitting the typical appearance.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible wheels are proportional to the vehicle size, resembling standard commercial van wheels with dark rims.
The window configuration and overall dimensions suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters on the license plate are distorted and illegible, appearing as melted or nonsensical shapes rather than clear alphanumeric characters. This is a common AI artifact.
The text on the digital display is blurry and lacks sharp character definition, appearing as glowing blobs rather than distinct letters.

artifact_observations.location: Right side mirror and door handle area
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and lack of crisp mechanical detail in the side mirror assembly and door handles compared to the rest of the vehicle body.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle class and distinguish it from similar vans or full-size buses.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and structural correctness of the text elements, which showed signs of gibberish.
To check for edge bleeding between the vehicle and the background, and ensure the body panels are topologically sound.
To verify that the wheels are properly grounded and not floating or melting into the pavement.

focus_areas: Text legibility on license plate and destination sign
Structural integrity of wheel arches and tire contact points
Sharpness of body panel lines and mirrors
Consistency of perspective in background buildings
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the license plate text; AI often fails here. Verify if the 'gibberish' is severe enough to impact the overall realism score. Check if the side mirror geometry is physically plausible or if it merges oddly with the door frame.
